study: Focused compact-test weak SINDy preprocessing comparison
status: frozen before any noisy identification outcomes
noise_scaling: existing ODE per-coordinate std(ddof=1), PDE global std(ddof=0); all arms share identical noisy array
test_function: product over axes of (1-s^2)^4 for |s|<=1, zero elsewhere
test_windows: fixed physical supports and deterministic centers, identical across methods and sampling densities; centered at H+j*stride, periodic spatial centers 2*pi*j/16
quadrature: analytic integration of nodal-feature piecewise-linear interpolants; tensor-product in space-time; no observation differentiation
ode_library: all monomials through total degree3 (10 columns for VdP)
pde_library_change: The original nuisance u*u_xx is explicitly replaced by (u^2)_xx; all arms share this fully weak library; no direct strong-vs-weak library-matched causal claim
threshold_selection: oracle same as original benchmark: maximize (F1/(1+relative coefficient error), F1, -relative coefficient error), first ascending threshold wins exact tie
stlsq: existing solver; column-normalized ridge alpha1e-8, max12 support iterations, thresholds in physical coefficient units
tv: reuse revision_tv_comparison.tv_cv: 3 deterministic interior folds; observation-only standardized prediction error; original9 lambda grid; POD refit per training fold; tolerance1e-5; only reconstructed states passed to weak library
native_grids: raw,TV,POD,PODTV use observed grid; EDMD and linear-state interpolation use q5 grid. Same physical test supports with analytic nodal-feature-interpolant quadrature on each grid
reporting: all planned conditions and seeds, including failures; condition means/SE across5 independent seeds; pooled means, coefficient-error medians; paired score/F1/error changes; no retuning after outcomes
scope: controlled compact-test weak-SINDy diagnostic with oracle sparsity tuning, not a reproduction or performance assessment of full Messenger-Bortz WSINDy or PySINDy
